messages.subject: [Rpy] rpy2-2.7.4
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

Rpy2 2.7.4 is released and on pypi.

It mostly addresses compatibility with Python 3.5.

The migration of the doc to 'readthedocs' did not generate (written)
complains so we will keep it that way for now.

The changelog is in the doc:
http://rpy2.readthedocs.org/en/version_2.7.x/changes.html#release-2-7-4


L.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------

jupyter 4 / ipython 4 and beside the warning, %lsmagic doesnt show %R etc.
Trying %%R  I now get:

ERROR: Cell magic `%%R` not found.


Not good... Suggestions?

Francois
